reference_alignment_correction.cause: Asynchronous displayed output was compared with the current input instead of the logged completed result
reference_alignment_correction.unusable: out.raw.frame1 is black; out.raw.frame4 repeats result 1 after feature retirement

method_notes: Benchmark: three rotated/reversed interleaved trials, 48 warmup and 100 measured evaluations per model and trial, 1920x1080 -> 3840x2160 patterned inputs.
Quality uses a single reset and true recurrence, one pass over each sequence. 32+4+4 exact d4r D3D12 reference frames and 2 aligned NVIDIA-PTX-through-ZLUDA frames.
NVIDIA capture excludes its known watermark rectangle only. Other cases use full RGB frames. Any nonfinite RGB fails.
Static native ISA counts cover all executable functions in each object, including prep. They are not dynamic per-wave counts or cycle costs.
